description: Backend: add AppUserRepo query, StaffNotificationDto, StaffNotificationService, and StaffNotificationController. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 (the frontend) and must be completed first so the frontend has real endpoints to call.
acceptance_criteria: mvn compile in the backend directory produces BUILD SUCCESS with no errors
GET http://localhost:8112/api/staff/teachers with a valid auth cookie returns HTTP 200 and a JSON array
POST http://localhost:8112/api/staff/notify/teachers with body {"message":"Test"} and valid auth cookie returns HTTP 200 with {"successful":true,"data":"N teacher(s) notified"}
POST http://localhost:8112/api/staff/notify/individual with body {"phoneNumber":"+254705145256","message":"Test"} and valid auth cookie returns HTTP 200
ATService log line 'AT SMS response:' appears for each notify call when devMode is false
verification: cd c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\backend && mvn compile — must print BUILD SUCCESS
With backend running: curl -X GET http://localhost:8112/api/staff/teachers -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --cookie '<auth-cookie>' — expects HTTP 200 JSON array

With backend running: curl -X POST http://localhost:8112/api/staff/notify/individual -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --cookie '<auth-cookie>' -d '{"phoneNumber":"+254705145256","message":"FEAT-001 test"}' — expects HTTP 200 {"successful":true}
